title: 下一步行动题
goal: 区分提议与决定，核对最终行动的执行者和顺序。

points.label: 核对行动的执行者与先后次序

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 下一步行动的教学内容与课程小测规格

body.p: 下一步行动题问对话结束时已经定下的行动。提议、原计划和被拒绝的方案，都要与最后定下的安排分开。

body.box:
A: Shall we take the bus?
B: The bus is late. Let's walk.
A: All right.

body.p: take the bus 是提议；Let's walk 得到 All right 的回应，因此双方决定步行。

steps.d: 先看题干问的是谁。What will Nina do next 问的是 Nina 的行动。
听出提议或原计划，再听对方的回应。Shall we take the bus 是乘车的提议，对方可能接受，也可能拒绝。
注意 will、instead 和表示同意的回应。I'll walk instead 表示改为步行。
first、then 和 after 表示行动的先后。I'll call first, then leave 表示先打电话，再离开。

cards.title: 计划与决定
rows: 提议
Shall we cycle? — Yes, let's.
对方回答 Yes, let's，骑车才定下来。
原计划
I was going to cycle, but I'll walk.
原计划是骑车，最后决定步行。
将来安排
I'm going to call Kim after lunch.
事先定好的安排：午饭后打电话。
当场决定
The door is locked. I'll find the key.
will 表示说话时当场做的决定。
替代
The road is closed; we'll take the train instead.
instead 引出替代的方案：改乘火车。
回应
Let's meet at six. — All right.
All right 表示同意，六点见面定下来。

cards.title: 执行者与顺序
rows: A: I'll fetch the map. B: I'll buy tickets.
A 取地图，B 买票。
两项行动分属不同的人。
A: I'll make tea first, then set the table. B: I'll wash cups.
A 先沏茶，再摆桌。
first 和 then 表示顺序。
A: Can you call Mei? B: Yes, after I finish this letter.
B 先写完信，再给 Mei 打电话。
after 后面是先做的事。
A: I'll pack the plates. B: I'll carry them outside.
A 装盘子，B 拿出去。
代词 them 指 plates。
A: Shall I print it? B: No, I'll print it.
B 打印。
B 拒绝了 A 的提议，自己打印。
A: You take the books. B: All right; I'll take them upstairs.
B 把书拿到楼上。
B 同意，并说明拿到楼上。

body.box:
A: I was going to collect the chairs. Could you carry the boxes?
B: The boxes are heavy. I'll collect the chairs instead.
A: All right. I'll carry the boxes.

What will the second speaker do?
1. Carry the boxes.
2. Collect the chairs.
3. Carry the boxes with the first speaker.
4. Leave the chairs to the first speaker.

body.p: 第二位说话者用 instead 改为去拿椅子。第一位说话者同意，自己搬箱子。第二项是最终的分工。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 原计划
I was going to cycle, but I'll walk → cycle
答案是改变后的决定：步行。
拒绝方案
Shall we take the bus? — No, let's walk → take the bus
被拒绝的方案不选，选 let's 后面的方案。
换人
I'll fetch the map; you buy tickets → I buy tickets
逐个核对动作的主语：买票的是对方。
换顺序
Call first, then leave → leave first
first 后面的动作在前：先打电话。

lines.text: Shall we take the bus to the swimming pool? It usually stops outside, but the road is closed for repairs today.
Let's walk instead. It isn't far.
All right.

items.stem: How will the speakers go to the pool?
items.why: Let's walk instead 得到 All right 的回应，双方决定步行。

lines.text: Mira, can you call the driver about the delivery? I'll put the boxes near the door while you finish writing the address.
Yes, I'll call as soon as I've finished the address.

items.stem: What will Mira do before calling the driver?
options: Write a note to the driver
items.why: Mira 说 as soon as I've finished the address，先写完地址再打电话。

lines.text: I was going to bring the cake to the picnic, but I won't have time to bake it. Could you bring one instead?
Yes. I'll bake it tonight and bring it tomorrow.

options: The second speaker after the picnic
items.why: 第二位说话者接受请求并说 I'll bake it tonight and bring it tomorrow。

lines.text: The museum is crowded today. We could go to the park instead, or wait here until the next group goes inside.
Let's wait for the next group.
Agreed.

items.why: Let's wait for the next group 得到 Agreed 的回应，第一项是决定。

lines.text: I was going to cycle to the concert, but my bicycle has a flat tire. I'll take the train instead and meet you there.
Fine. I'll meet you at the entrance.

items.stem: How will the first speaker travel?
options: By train after fixing the tire
items.why: I'll take the train instead 表明改乘火车去音乐会。

lines.text: Leo, could you set the tables for the lunch? I'll wash the cups while you find the clean tablecloths in the cupboard.
Certainly. I'll get the tablecloths and set the tables.

options: Find the cups in the cupboard
items.why: Leo 回答 I'll get the tablecloths and set the tables，第二项符合他的任务。

lines.text: Shall we move the meeting to Friday? The room is available then, although we could also meet online on Thursday this week.
Let's meet online on Thursday.
That works for me.

options: To meet in the room on Friday
To meet in the room on Thursday
items.why: Let's meet online on Thursday 得到 That works 的回应，第三项是最终安排。

lines.text: I'll pick up the posters from the printer. Would you put them on the noticeboards when I get back to the school?
Sure. I'll put them up after you return.

items.stem: What will the second speaker do after the first returns?
items.why: 第二位说话者答应 I'll put them up after you return，them 指海报。

lines.text: The shop has run out of red paper for the signs. We could use blue paper, or wait until the red paper arrives tomorrow.
Let's use blue today.
All right.

items.stem: What will the speakers use for the signs?
items.why: Let's use blue today 获得同意，第一项符合决定。

lines.text: Can you deliver the books to Ms King now? I need to phone her about the list, and the books are on the desk.
I'll deliver them after I check the list with you.

items.stem: What will the second speaker do first?
options: Phone Ms King about the list
Check the list with the first speaker
Deliver the books to Ms King
Put the books on the desk
items.why: after I check the list 表明先核对清单，再送书。
